notes.title: Withering Reflections | Developer Diary - Entry #2: Building the Foundations
notes.content:
Greetings, community!

The journey of developing Withering Reflections continues with significant strides forward, and we’re excited to share the latest updates with you. Over the past few weeks, we’ve been deep in the trenches of code, refining the very core of the game to deliver an even more immersive and engaging experience. Despite the inevitable challenges, the progress we’ve made has been incredibly rewarding and marks a crucial step in the game’s evolution.

[b]New Abilities for Killers and Survivors[/b]
One of the major highlights of this period has been the successful implementation of new abilities for both killers and survivors. These additions are designed to enrich the strategic depth and variety of gameplay, ensuring every match feels unique and dynamic. Each new ability is carefully crafted to align with the game’s themes of fear, survival, and the power of reflection, making your choices even more impactful in the heat of the moment.

[b]Level Refinement and Optimization[/b]
Our first two production levels have undergone extensive refinement and optimization. These improvements have significantly enhanced in-game performance, providing smoother gameplay and more responsive mechanics. We’ve also started laying the foundation for our third level, which brings with it fresh concepts and possibilities. Early development is always an exciting phase, and we can’t wait to reveal more as this new environment takes shape!

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
While the focus has been primarily on coding and gameplay mechanics recently, we’re eager to shift gears soon and showcase more visual updates in the near future. This time, we don’t have any preview images to share, but rest assured that our next dev diary will be packed with exciting new visuals and content.

[b]Join the Conversation[/b]
Want to stay updated and share your thoughts on Withering Reflections? Join our growing community on Discord, where you’ll get behind-the-scenes insights, sneak peeks, and the chance to connect with fellow players: https://discord.gg/S5ujaPvPMY

Until next time, keep reflecting on your fears—Withering Reflections is getting closer to becoming a reality!

notes.title: Withering Reflections | Developer Diary - Entry 1: Embracing the Horror Journey
notes.content:
Greetings, horror enthusiasts!

Since the release of DreamBack VR, we’ve been hard at work conceptualizing a project that takes horror to new, terrifying heights. This time, we’re venturing into uncharted territory with an interactive, multiplayer focus. Our vision? To create a chilling, cooperative experience where teamwork, interaction, and fear collide.

[b]A New Direction: Multiplayer Horror[/b]
Enter Withering Reflections, a multiplayer 4v1 asymmetrical horror game where fear is both your enemy and your greatest ally. Players take on the roles of either survivors or killers in a haunting realm governed by the enigmatic force known as the Echo.

[b]Current Progress[/b]
We’re excited to share that Withering Reflections is already in its early multiplayer peer-to-peer stage! Here’s where we currently stand:

[b]Characters [/b]
The roster includes two killers and four survivors, each with their own rich backstories and compelling reasons for being trapped in this twisted world.

[b]Core Mechanics[/b]
Prototyping is well underway for gameplay mechanics, including unique abilities for killers and survivors. These are being carefully balanced to ensure a challenging yet rewarding experience.
Gameplay Elements: From reflection-based mechanics to dynamic hide-and-seek strategies, we’re working to make every match tense, unpredictable, and immersive.

[b]Early Development [/b]
UI, settings, icons, and controls are still in their infancy, but these elements will receive dedicated attention as we progress.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
Our journey has just begun. The road ahead is filled with challenges, but it’s also brimming with opportunities to create something extraordinary. With your support, we’ll continue to push boundaries, refine mechanics, and craft an experience that horror fans will remember.

[b]Join the Conversation[/b]
Want to stay updated and share your thoughts on Withering Reflections? Join our growing community on Discord, where you’ll get behind-the-scenes insights, sneak peeks, and the chance to connect with fellow players: https://discord.gg/S5ujaPvPMY

Stay tuned for more updates—and as always, watch your reflection. The Echo is waiting.
